title: Unity support boundary
description: Ordered rules that classify every contract and sidecar leaf the Unity target sees. Patterns are `<source>:<keyed pointer glob>`; the first matching rule wins. Leaves are identity-keyed JSON pointers: array elements carrying `name`/`part` are keyed by it, and prop members are keyed `<role>:<name>` where role is channel-value, channel-default, channel-change, form-field or plain, derived from the contract's own channels and form blocks. A leaf no rule matches fails generation (UNITY_BOUNDARY_UNCLASSIFIED); a leaf an allowlisted component can only reach through a catchAll rule fails generation (UNITY_BOUNDARY_UNADJUDICATED).

phases.description: Human summary of what each parity phase lowers; the rules reference these ids.

via.description: lowered: the emitter or shared-runtime mechanism that realises the family today.

phase.description: pending: the parity phase that lowers the family.

reason.description: pending/refused: why the family is not lowered now (refused: why UI Toolkit cannot realise it idiomatically).

valueIn.description: Restrict the rule to scalar leaves whose value is one of these.

catchAll.description: A family-level fallback an allowlisted component may not rely on.
